As the Academic Personnel (AP) Analyst 3, you will serve as the department’s subject matter expert for academic personnel matters, managing faculty recruitment, appointments, advancements, separations, dossier preparation, leave administration, benefits, payroll, and employee relations.

You will advise faculty and leadership on academic personnel policies, ensure compliance with university and departmental guidelines, and coordinate credentialing, privileging, visa sponsorships, and special licensing programs. This role requires strong analytical skills, sound judgment, and the ability to independently resolve personnel and payroll issues while providing strategic guidance to support departmental goals.
This position has a target salary of $80,700.00

Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with staff, managers, and colleagues within and outside DGSOM.
